summary: Realty Income Corporation filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) on June 29, 2026, providing updates on capital raising, liquidity, and financing matters. It describes its $4.0 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, a $1.38 billion fund credit facility, and commercial paper programs. The filing is a routine update on existing credit facilities and liquidity sources, with no price, stake, premium, or structural terms typical of a special situation. No event reflects an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. This is a standard corporate liquidity disclosure. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; this is ordinary business reporting.
